headline: French Economy Unexpectedly Contracts in Third Quarter as Exports Slump
summary: The French economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter as exports slumped, investment continued to decline, and inflation neared a three-year high.
why: France is the second-largest economy in the eurozone, and unexpected contractions signal broader macroeconomic weakness across the European Union.
why_moved: An unexpected economic contraction combined with rising inflation and falling exports dampens growth expectations for the eurozone.
